# File Upload

Lets users select and upload files from their device. A dashed drop area with an upload icon, instruction text, supported-formats hint, and a browse button; selected files appear below as flat rows with a status icon, the file name, and a remove action. Errors wrap the row in red and attach a message strip. Rebuilt to match the DGA library's dga-file-upload anatomy exactly.

**Stylesheet:** `components/file-upload/file-upload.css`

**Behaviour:** `js/components/file-upload.js` (classes `FileUploadManager`); wired through `[data-remove]`, `[data-fu-root]`, `[data-browse]`. Without it the markup renders but does not open, close or toggle.

Layout wrappers named `showcase-*` belong to the documentation page, not to the component: leave them out.

## Props / Configuration

All available CSS classes, mapped from the library's dga-file-upload API.

| Class | Type | Library prop | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `.file-upload` | Base | — | Column container (max-width 334px) holding the drop area and the files list. |
| `.file-upload--drag-over` | State | `drag-state` | Brand tint with a green dashed border while a file hovers the area. |
| `.file-upload--disabled` | State | `disabled` | Gray fill, muted text, all interaction blocked. |
| `.file-upload__drop-area` | Element | — | A <label> for the hidden input: dashed SVG border, upload icon, instructions, formats hint, and the browse button. |
| .file-upload__instructions / __formats | Element | title, file-types-text | 16px medium instruction line and the 12px supported-formats hint. |
| `.file-upload__input` | Element | accept, multiple | The visually-hidden native <input type="file">. |
| .file-upload__files-list / __file-item | Element | `files` | Flat gray rows: status slot, file name, and a small close button. |
| .file-upload__file-status--complete\|--error / __spinner | Element | `upload-status` | Green check when complete, red icon on error, tiny spinner while uploading. |
| .file-upload__file-item--error + __file-item-msg | Element | `error-message` | Red-bordered wrapper: the file row on top, the error message strip below. |

## Drop Area

Default, drag-over, and disabled. The dashed border is an SVG stroke (12 / 6.5 dashes), swapping from gray to Saudi green while a file hovers.

```html
<div class="file-upload">
    <label class="file-upload__drop-area">
        <span class="file-upload__icon"><span class="icon dga-icon-file-upload"></span></span>
        <div class="file-upload__content">
            <p class="file-upload__instructions">Drag and drop your files here</p>
            <p class="file-upload__formats">Max 2MB — .jpg, .png, and .pdf</p>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary-solid btn-medium">Browse files</button>
    </label>
</div>
<div class="file-upload file-upload--drag-over">
    <label class="file-upload__drop-area">
        <span class="file-upload__icon"><span class="icon dga-icon-file-upload"></span></span>
        <div class="file-upload__content">
            <p class="file-upload__instructions">Drop it to upload</p>
            <p class="file-upload__formats">Max 2MB — .jpg, .png, and .pdf</p>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary-solid btn-medium" disabled="">Browse files</button>
    </label>
</div>
<div class="file-upload file-upload--disabled">
    <label class="file-upload__drop-area">
        <span class="file-upload__icon"><span class="icon dga-icon-file-upload"></span></span>
        <div class="file-upload__content">
            <p class="file-upload__instructions">Drag and drop your files here</p>
            <p class="file-upload__formats">Max 2MB — .jpg, .png, and .pdf</p>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary-solid btn-medium" disabled="">Browse files</button>
    </label>
</div>
```

## File Items

Uploading shows a tiny spinner; complete shows the green check; an error wraps the row with a red border and attaches the message strip below.

```html
<div class="file-upload">
    <div class="file-upload__files-list">
        <div class="file-upload__file-item">
            <span class="file-upload__file-status"><span class="file-upload__spinner" aria-label="Uploading"></span></span>
            <span class="file-upload__file-name">File-name.csv</span>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-transparent btn-icon-only btn-small" aria-label="Remove file">
                <span class="icon dga-icon-multiplication-sign"></span>
            </button>
        </div>
        <div class="file-upload__file-item">
            <span class="file-upload__file-status file-upload__file-status--complete"><span class="icon dga-icon-checkmark-circle-02 solid rounded"></span></span>
            <span class="file-upload__file-name">File-name.csv</span>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-transparent btn-icon-only btn-small" aria-label="Remove file">
                <span class="icon dga-icon-multiplication-sign"></span>
            </button>
        </div>
        <div class="file-upload__file-item--error">
            <div class="file-upload__file-item">
                <span class="file-upload__file-status file-upload__file-status--error"><span class="icon dga-icon-checkmark-circle-04 solid rounded"></span></span>
                <span class="file-upload__file-name">File-name.csv</span>
                <button type="button" class="btn btn-transparent btn-icon-only btn-small" aria-label="Remove file">
                    <span class="icon dga-icon-multiplication-sign"></span>
                </button>
            </div>
            <div class="file-upload__file-item-msg">File exceeds the 2MB size limit.</div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
```

## RTL Layout
